name: Motion Technology Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Motion Technology Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated company, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of electric motors. These essential components are integrated into a variety of applications, such as medical apparatus, powered wheelchairs, personal mobility scooters, lifts, and advanced power transmission systems. The company's extensive product line includes diverse motor technologies like brush DC motors, brushless DC motors, servo motors, and induction motors. They also provide complementary products such as BLDC drivers, reluctance motor controls, and electric logistics equipment. Motion Technology Electric & Machinery serves a broad international clientele, with significant sales in regions including the United States, Europe, Australia, South Korea, and India. Established in 2002, the firm operates its main office from Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
